comment: What a wrapped tool's reply looks like once Wakeshift's block is added (docs/subscribe-from-tools.md, "The block, added automatically"): result is what the handler returned (a string, or a CallToolResult), addition is /calls/addition's answer (the top-level one unless the case has its own), want is the reply. A structured result (structuredContent an object) carries the block's text, without the beacon, in its wakeshift field, whether or not the tool's output type declares it. output_schemas is how tools/list gives a wrapped tool's output schema: an object schema gains an optional wakeshift string. Every SDK's tests read it; Go's skips the string cases (its handlers return a CallToolResult).

addition.text: Wakeshift: this conversation is woken by Monitor.
